messages.author: 074c5125059cac06
messages.subject: Multiple External Functions with GGIR?
parts:
Hi colleagues,

I’m working on a project benchmarking our in-house step count algorithm against several other algorithms (e.g., Verisense). Since all these algorithms require using GGIR external functions, I wanted to ask if GGIR supports the use of multiple external functions within a single workflow?

Thanks,
Xiaoyu

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Multiple External Functions with GGIR?
parts:
Hi Xiaoyu,

I am afraid this is not possible at the moment.

I am happy to develop this functionality as part of a paid consultancy. Please pm me if you are interested such that I can send you a quote.

Are you planning to open-source your step detection algorithm?

Thanks,

Vincent
